comment: Independent C-first entry recipe for uhitm.c:mhitm_ad_ssex through hero-to-monster damageum. A male Wizard becomes the Incubus form of the amorous demon and creates one hostile goblin. The recorded C map places the goblin directly north in the same column as the hero-form glyph, so k is the source-observed attack direction. The fresh seed/date and target are independent of the admitted combat case.
